messages:
amanda: Quick q — should the console badge for 'who changed X' show the raw actor or the consolidated actor hint? :thinking:

audit-bot: Deploy notice — audit-exporter v1.3 rolled to canary in prod.

devin: What do we mean by "consolidated actor hint"? an alias from identity service?

amanda: yes. when we resolve external actors (SCIM, SSO) we sometimes show a friendly alias not the raw principal id. question: do we expose alias in exports and SIEM webhooks or strip to principal id for forensics?

raj: My leaning: exports should include both `actor_id` and `actor_hint`. console badge can show hint. SIEM/webhook consumers likely want both for correlation.

mike: must add PII/redaction controls. some customers can't have emails in logs. we need export modes: `full`, `redacted`, `redacted_plus_alias`.

katie: telemetry note — if we add alias we might increase cardinality. prefer small flag in event `has_actor_hint:true` rather than always storing alias string unless requested.

devin: operationally, what's the default? full or redacted? security/compliance teams will default redacted.

amanda: default = redacted for enterprise orgs. self-serve orgs default = full. but we must document and surface in Console before export: a badge that says "contains PII" with `Confirm export` button.

raj: API shape proposal (sketch):
```
POST /v1/audit/exports
{ "org_id": "o_123", "since": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z", "mode": "redacted_plus_alias", "delivery": {"type":"s3","bucket":"..."} }
```
Response includes `job_id` and `estimated_size_bytes`.

mike: add `pii_profile` param that controls redaction rules (email, ip, user_display). defaults per org.

katie: UX: badge states: "Export will include actor_aliases — user-visible names. Learn more" — link to docs + must click to acknowledge. Also show quota meter (e.g., 23/100 exports this month).

devin: quota decisions: limit 100 exports/org/month by default, rate limit 2 exports/min, size cap 100MB per export. Need to track billing + telemetry when customers request overrides.

amanda: agreed. also for SIEM webhooks we should always send events as structured JSON with two actor fields and a `redaction_level` header so SIEM can filter.

raj: one more thing — replayability for forensics. we should include `change_delta` as ndjson with `before`/`after` snippets and a cryptographic `event_id` so downstream can verify ordering.

mike: sample NDJSON line:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T15:01:23Z","event_id":"ev_9f8a","actor_id":"u_123","actor_hint":"Amanda P","redaction_level":"redacted_plus_alias","change":{"path":"/routing/policy/123","before":"{...}","after":"{...}"}}
```

katie: telemetry: emit metrics for export success/fail, percent redacted, alias_included boolean. console should surface small chart of successful exports last 30 days.

amanda: open questions:
• sara_legal: retention defaults for exports? (delete after 90d?)
• ops: how heavy is `estimated_size_bytes` calc — do we sample or compute exact?

sara_legal: we'll prefer shorter retention by default for regulated customers, but legal wants opt-in longer storage per contract. i'll draft guidance.

devin: For estimate we can sample first 1000 events and extrapolate. that seems cheap and good enough.

raj: I'll draft API PR for `audit-export` with the fields above. Mike, can you write the redaction logic and PII profile enum?

mike: on it, will sketch rules and add unit tests.

amanda: sweet. I'll update console mockups with the badge and confirmation modal. schedule a short sync tomorrow 10am.

katie: ack, will add telemetry dashboards.

devin: :thumbsup:

amanda: thanks all — recording decisions in the audit RFC repo.
